chunks.title: Sandcastle Motor Insurance (fictional)
chunks.text: # Sandcastle Motor Insurance (fictional) This is a wholly synthetic portfolio policy, not a real insurance product. Document ID: motor. The motor policy covers accidental collision damage to the insured vehicle. The collision deductible is EGP 2000 for each claim. Drivers must be at least 25 years old and hold a valid driving licence. Windscreen repairs are covered up to EGP 5000 per policy year without a deductible. Theft claims require a police report submitted within 48 hours of discovering the theft. Personal belongings inside the vehicle are excluded. Roadside assistance includes towing up to 80 kilometres from the breakdown location. Flood damage is excluded unless the flood extension is listed on the schedule. The cancellation notice period is 14 calendar days.

chunks.title: Paper Lantern Medical Insurance (fictional)
chunks.text: # Paper Lantern Medical Insurance (fictional) This is a wholly synthetic portfolio policy, not a real insurance product. Document ID: medical. The medical policy covers inpatient hospital treatment up to EGP 300000 per member per year. Planned hospital admissions require pre-authorisation at least 72 hours before admission. Emergency admission must be reported within 24 hours. Outpatient consultations have a copayment of 20 percent. Dental treatment is limited to EGP 2500 per member per year. Cosmetic surgery is excluded unless medically necessary following an accident. Pre-existing conditions have a waiting period of 180 days. Prescription medicines must be obtained from a network pharmacy. Maternity treatment has a waiting period of 10 months and a limit of EGP 20000.

chunks.title: Cloud Kite Travel Insurance (fictional)
chunks.text: # Cloud Kite Travel Insurance (fictional) This is a wholly synthetic portfolio policy, not a real insurance product. Document ID: travel. The travel policy covers trips up to 30 consecutive days. Emergency overseas medical expenses are covered up to USD 50000. The policy excludes professional sports and mountaineering above 4000 metres. Baggage delay lasting more than 12 hours qualifies for reimbursement of essential purchases up to USD 200. Lost baggage has a maximum benefit of USD 1000 and requires a carrier loss report. Trip cancellation due to a documented acute illness is covered up to USD 3000. Visa refusal is excluded. Claims must be submitted within 21 days after returning home, with original receipts and proof of travel.

chunks.title: Origami Harbour Home Insurance (fictional)
chunks.text: # Origami Harbour Home Insurance (fictional) This is a wholly synthetic portfolio policy, not a real insurance product. Document ID: home. The home policy covers fire damage to household contents up to EGP 400000. Water leakage from internal pipes is covered with a deductible of EGP 1500 per incident. Gradual damp and mould are excluded. Alternative accommodation is reimbursed for up to 20 nights when a covered fire makes the home uninhabitable. Jewellery is limited to EGP 10000 in total unless individually listed on the schedule. Unoccupied homes must be inspected every 14 days. Commercial stock stored at home is excluded. A contents inventory and photographs are required for a fire claim.

chunks.title: شركة الفانوس الورقي للتأمين الطبي (خيالية)
chunks.text: # شركة الفانوس الورقي للتأمين الطبي (خيالية) هذه وثيقة تجريبية مصطنعة بالكامل لأغراض العرض وليست منتج تأمين حقيقي. معرف الوثيقة: medical-ar. تغطي الوثيقة جلسات العلاج الطبيعي بحد أقصى ١٢ جلسة في السنة بعد موافقة مسبقة. يجب تقديم طلب الموافقة مرفقاً بتقرير الطبيب المعالج وخطة العلاج. تبلغ نسبة تحمل الكشف الطبي ١٥ بالمائة من قيمة الزيارة داخل الشبكة الطبية. تغطية النظارات الطبية بحد أقصى ١٨٠٠ جنيه كل سنتين وتشمل العدسات والإطار. مهلة تقديم المطالبة الطبية هي ٣٠ يوماً من تاريخ الخدمة مع الفاتورة الأصلية والتقرير الطبي. لا تشمل التغطية المكملات الغذائية أو علاجات إنقاص الوزن. خدمة الاستشارات الهاتفية متاحة طوال اليوم للحالات غير الطارئة.
